Ledgered like the other folder controls, so undo removes only what Toolport wrote; the file itself is never changed and a managed policy CLAUDE.md cannot be left out. dry_run is on by default: the call previews and writes only with dry_run=false

tools.description: Measure what a folder really loads, in tokens, by asking Claude Code itself: one request per variant (as is, each without entry, the bundle), which spends model tokens and is cached per Claude Code version, model, settings and variant. Without start=true and without a cached answer it only returns the plan and starts nothing. The result separates the estimated instruction rows from the part that is not itemised, gives each variant's delta, verifies the rows against the InstructionsLoaded log and carries the calibration factor
tools.name: context_measure

params.description: The folder where Claude Code starts
params.name: cwd

params.name: model

params.description: Measure again instead of answering from the cache
params.name: force

params.description: Start the request; without it a cache miss returns the plan only
params.name: start
